card.name: Start of bacteriostatic after 'no preservative'
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word 'bacteriostatic' (bacter) right after 'no' or 'no preservative or' in statements about injection solutions. It also fires weakly on the N of NAGS after 'due to'.

modes.label: Bacteriostatic wording
modes.description: The start of 'bacteriostatic' in notes that a solution has no preservative or bacteriostatic agent.
modes.example: Aseptic technique must be strictly observed in all handling since no preservative or<< bacter>>iostatic agent is present in CRE

modes.label: NAGS deficiency
modes.description: The N that begins NAGS after 'Hyperammonemia due to'.
modes.example: Acute Hyperammonemia due to<< N>>AGS Deficiency 50 mg
